overview.financial: As of 1st Oct 2026, in terms of occupancy for Oct2026 we are below 9.47% compared to the budget at the moment. Following our ADR below 5.70% compared to the budget for 2026 and in terms of Revenue, we are 15.95% below our budget for 2026. Our strategy remains driving occupancy in filling up Oct onwards with Last Minute Promotion through ads to boost our direct bookings, Q3 Packages on websites and OTA, also doing more Telemarketing, and joining the campaign with OTA to grab more last-minute bookings to maximize the Room Revenue and keeping the ADR above the budget with yield pricing

Market : Russia
Update :
Conducted a product experience and quality check, including the spa treatments, restaurant offerings, room categories, and overall hotel facilities.
The Russian market continues to show a similar pickup pattern to last year, particularly for next year’s travel period. Russian guests continue to travel across different seasons rather than being concentrated in one specific period.

Update :
Their main Bali destinations continue to be Ubud, Nusa Dua, Jimbaran, and Seminyak, with Ubud and Seminyak already supporting our properties.
